text:
nina: Who's up for a tiny lunchtime series next week? 'Core & Crux Ladder'  mix of a 10-min core circuit + a 10-min boulder ladder. low fuss.
nina: Plan: Mon/Wed/Fri do a 20min session (10 core + 10 movement) OR swap for 20min of stair intervals. 1pt/day.
cal: love a short structured thing. count me in.
sara: what's the core circuit? I'm terrible at remembering moves.
ben: suggested core: 3 rounds of 30s plank, 20s hollow hold, 15s side plank each, 1min rest. quick and effective.
lia: ooh will do. can we have a Wednesday group meet for bouldering practice?
nina: yes — optional meet Wed 12:30 at Crux gym for a 10-min group ladder then back to desks.
cal: perfect. @poll-bot can you poll for Wednesday group vs solo?
poll-bot: POLL: "Wednesday 12:30 meetup for Core & Crux Ladder" \u2014 Options: "12:30 group at Crux", "No meetup (solo)" \u2014 Vote now!
sara: voted group.
lia: voted group.
ben: voted solo (might be on calls).
nina: scoring: 1pt per day logged. +1 bonus if you post a short clip or sweaty selfie. keep it chill.
cal: tiny tracker? or just post here?
nina: made a tiny sheet: https://tinyurl.com/core-crux-ladder (name + days + notes). no policing, just kudos.
sara: can we add a "modification" column for tendon-friendly options?
ben: good idea. added a "mod" column.
lia: small prize: winner gets snack credit + eternal glory GIF. losers bring pretzels.
cal: and a 'most improved' bonus? highest pct improvement gets a bonus coffee voucher.
nina: added that too.
poll-bot: POLL RESULTS: "Wednesday 12:30 meetup for Core & Crux Ladder" \u2014 12:30 group at Crux (3 votes), No meetup (solo) (1 vote).
sara: looks like a little crew will show. I'll bring chalk and moral support.
ben: if anyone wants a prehab shoulder warmup, DM me, I can drop a 3min routine.
nina: kickoff Monday. post a short note when you finish a session so we can cheer. friendly, low-key vibes only. :sparkles: :muscle:
